SELECT count(*) n, count(distinct sales_line_id) ids, count(distinct (receipt_id, line_no)) rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(distinct etl_loaded_at) loads, max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-05-04'

SELECT d.fiscal_week, count(*) n, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) ids, count(distinct (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) rl, sum(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(distinct st.store_id) stores
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-08' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nb, count(distinct store_id) rstores FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-08' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.sale_date, lines, net, stores, nb, rstores FROM s FULL JOIN r ON r.business_date=s.sale_date ORDER BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.ns, c.rs, m.ns-c.rs diff FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(c.rs,0)) DESC LIMIT 15

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1,2,3),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900),
lfl AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id=ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364))
SELECT cs.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN w.ns END) ty_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN w.ns END) ly_all,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN w.ns END) ty_lfl,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN w.ns END) ly_lfl,
  count(distinct CASE WHEN l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN w.store_id END) lfl_stores
FROM weekly w JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=w.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN lfl l ON l.store_id=w.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=w.fiscal_week
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales) rs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT count(*) n, sum(abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(c.rs,0))) totdiff, max(abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(c.rs,0))) maxdiff FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, sum(net_sales) ns FROM net_lines WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, sum(net_sales) rs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-09-28' AND store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT coalesce(m.business_date,c.business_date) d, coalesce(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.ns, c.rs FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id AND c.business_date=m.business_date
WHERE abs(coalesce(m.ns,0)-coalesce(c.rs,0))>0.01 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 40

SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n, count(distinct f.sales_line_id) ids, count(distinct (f.receipt_id,f.line_no)) rl, count(distinct f.etl_loaded_at) loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at), sum(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-14' AND DATE '2025-09-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) dup_groups, sum(c) rows_in_groups FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)

WITH sales_dedup AS (
    -- one row per receipt line: the double load of store 116, 15-21 Sep 2025, is collapsed
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn
        FROM fact_sales_line f) WHERE rn = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS ns
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-05-04' - 364)
),
by_region AS (
  SELECT cs.region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN w.ns END) AS ty_all,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN w.ns END) AS ly_all,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN w.ns END) AS ty_lfl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND l.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN w.ns END) AS ly_lfl
  FROM weekly w
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = w.store_id AND cs.is_current
  LEFT JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = w.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = w.fiscal_week
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ty_lfl/ly_lfl DESC) AS rank, region,
       'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year,
       ROUND(ty_all,2) AS net_sales_ytd,
       ROUND(100.0*(ty_lfl/ly_lfl-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       ROUND(100.0*(ty_all/ly_all-1),2) AS total_growth_pct,
       ROUND(ty_lfl,2) ty_lfl, ROUND(ly_lfl,2) ly_lfl, ROUND(ly_all,2) ly_all
FROM by_region ORDER BY rank
